class: a user with no reachable browser, or a second device, can only answer in prose or a paste, and every reaction on the board costs a copy and a message
caught_by: the live tier, offered once on Claude Code with a consent line: the owner's page saves each change as one document that holds the Copy block verbatim, one write at a time with the newest state winning, while a person's page writes only when they press Send, waits once for what they would miss as Copy does, and then opens the comment box on its answer; nothing is written before the page's first settled read, a reload or a restored row writes nothing back, a newer round stops a page writing, a row restores only marks the page itself writes, and the owner's name is pinned to the account; every card and the answer box carry a DOM id, and a Comment button opens the shell's composer until the view says it has none; a refused or missing capability leaves the offline page and Copy whole. The agent's own rules, applying a row once per version recorded in live.json and a person's row only after the owner confirms whose it is, are prose in live.md that the tests hold only as the shape of live.json
missed_by: the local page alone, whose marks reach the agent only through a clipboard the user pastes, and which cannot be shown over SSH or on the web

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
